description: This source file contains network I/O functions for reading and writing data over sockets, including handling EINTR interruptions, network write with sendfile support, and network read with buffer management. It also has functions for error handling and socket options like TCP_CORK.

methods.name: GQuark li_network_error_quark(void)
methods.description: Returns a GQuark for network error strings.

methods.name: ssize_t li_net_write(int fd,void * buf,ssize_t nbyte)
methods.description: Performs write operation on a file descriptor, repeating if interrupted by EINTR.

methods.name: ssize_t li_net_read(int fd,void * buf,ssize_t nbyte)
methods.description: Performs read operation on a file descriptor, repeating if interrupted by EINTR.

methods.name: liNetworkStatus li_network_write(int fd,liChunkQueue * cq,goffset write_max,GError ** err)
methods.description: Writes data from a chunk queue to a socket, optionally utilizing TCP_CORK to optimize packet send.

methods.name: liNetworkStatus li_network_read(int fd,liChunkQueue * cq,goffset read_max,liBuffer ** buffer,GError ** err)
methods.description: Reads data from a socket into buffers, handling various socket states and buffer management.
